construction.eval_image: task image with all .git histories removed and one new initial commit; dependency environment and image CMD are retained.
construction.golden_patch: B-to-R code diff generated after reverse security_patch plus mask_patch; test_patch cancels from this diff.
construction.mask: an adaptive-generation agent proposes mask_patch against the vulnerable state; the curator filters text files, forbids file creation, requires deletions, and verifies application/reversal.
construction.rollback: reverse security_patch and, for repo-test tasks, reverse test_patch to form the vulnerable feature state before masking.
construction.source_event: base_commit is a real security-fix commit; security_patch is the production-code portion and test_patch is the test/configuration portion.
construction.task_patch: R-to-B diff produced after reverse security/test patches and applying mask_patch; used to build the task image.
construction.task_statement: generated from mask_patch and later checked not to reference tests; it is not independently authored from the masked implementation.

evaluation.focal_security: test_patch then candidate/state patch; execute image CMD; expected threshold is the capped functionality threshold plus expected_pf.sec
evaluation.functionality: candidate/state patch only; execute image CMD; parse with per-instance logs_handler; pass when observed breaks do not exceed expected_pf.func
evaluation.prediction_filter: removes edits to files touched by test_patch and binary diff blocks
evaluation.task_and_security_independent: separate clean materializations and runs; common command/parser but security-only test_patch is sealed

B.reconstruction: pull pinned eval image digest and extract /project
B.security_status: focal vulnerable implementation absent; security tests not installed

R.definition: secure implementation completing the same feature

states.u_to_r: apply security_patch forward to U and require the R non-Git tree hash
